release_notes_zh:
v0.5.1 修复版：
- Excel 导出时间轴正确性：每 1 分钟呼吸表与行为分粒度表（1/3/5/10 分钟）的真实时间标签与数据窗口现在对齐墙钟整分钟（此前秒位非 0 起录时整表错标，按钟点读数会读到错误分钟）
- 「说明」页改为逐表陈述，不再虚报未产出的工作表
- 「呼吸指标_每秒」的 n 列改为整数显示；分钟表恢复冻结「真实时间 + 分钟」两列
- 安装版可直接覆盖 0.5.0（同 AppId，保留用户设置）
release_notes_en:
v0.5.1 (fix release):
- Excel export time-axis correctness: the per-minute respiratory table and the behavior granularity tables (1/3/5/10 min) now align data windows to wall-clock whole minutes; previously labels and data disagreed whenever a recording started off-minute
- The Notes sheet now describes only the sheets actually produced
- Per-second table n column shown as integer; per-minute table again freezes the time and minute columns
- Setup upgrades 0.5.0 in place, keeping user settings
